roles.title: Growth Product Manager (Senior to Staff)
roles.location: Remote - European Union; Remote - Latin America & the Caribbean; Remote - United Kingdom; Remote - USA

bullets: Own member growth, the growth strategy, and the prioritized backlog that moves it, and build the measurement framework the company uses to size and evaluate growth bets
Navigate the full funnel to achieve our growth goals, including acquisition, onboarding, activation, retention, reactivation, and referrals
Set the standard for how we run experiments end to end: hypothesis, instrumentation, analysis, iteration, and knowing when to stop
Use AI tooling to compress the loop from idea to shipped experiment, multiplying what a small, nimble team can ship
Keep the executive team clear on what you’re doing, why, and what you’re trading off
